WITH viewer AS (SELECT ? AS id) SELECT p.id,p.caption,p.alt_text AS altText,p.width,p.height,p.published_at AS publishedAt,p.state,p.object_key AS objectKey,profile.handle,profile.display_name AS displayName,p.user_id AS ownerId,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like l JOIN membership lm ON lm.user_id=l.user_id AND lm.status='active' WHERE l.post_id=p.id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM block WHERE (blocker_id=v.id AND target_id=l.user_id) OR (blocker_id=l.user_id AND target_id=v.id))) AS likeCount,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_like WHERE post_id=p.id AND user_id=v.id) AS liked,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c JOIN membership cm ON cm.user_id=c.user_id AND cm.status='active' WHERE c.post_id=p.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM block WHERE (blocker_id=v.id AND target_id=c.user_id) OR (blocker_id=c.user_id AND target_id=v.id))) AS commentCount
 FROM post p CROSS JOIN viewer v JOIN profile ON profile.user_id=p.user_id JOIN membership m ON m.user_id=p.user_id LEFT JOIN follow f ON f.target_id=p.user_id AND f.follower_id=v.id WHERE p.state='published' AND p.published_at<=? AND m.status='active' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM block b WHERE (b.blocker_id=v.id AND b.target_id=p.user_id) OR (b.blocker_id=p.user_id AND b.target_id=v.id)) AND (p.user_id=v.id OR f.status='accepted')
 AND p.user_id!=v.id AND f.status='accepted'
 AND (p.published_at<? OR (p.published_at=? AND p.id<?)) ORDER BY p.published_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT 13
